pattern.top_pattern: CT PPO acute spend is concentrated at Yale New Haven with both more admits and higher paid per admit
pattern.what_is_impacting: Commercial Local Group PPO acute hospitals in CT
pattern.pattern_details: CT PPO inpatient growth is heavily concentrated at YALE NEW HAVEN HOSPITAL. Both authorization-required and non-authorization acute admissions increased, and paid per admit also rose, pointing to combined volume and reimbursement pressure rather than a single coding issue. This is a provider-focused cost trend with clear UM and network levers.
pattern.why_it_matters: A single acute hospital appears to be driving a large share of CT inpatient cost growth, making this a high-value target for provider-specific action.
pattern.recommended_next_step: Launch a joint provider review for YALE NEW HAVEN HOSPITAL covering admission growth, level of care, authorization pathways, and contract performance for CT PPO acute stays.
evidence_summary: Authorization-required CT PPO acute claims at YALE NEW HAVEN HOSPITAL added about +$4.2M on 41 more admissions, with paid per admit up about $7.1K.
Non-authorization CT PPO acute claims added another +$1.1M on 50 more admissions, with paid per admit up about $3.1K.
The pattern is concentrated in one provider and one facility setting rather than spread broadly across CT.
